replay_semantics_vs_historical_pixels.semantics_to_reproduce: count 0 -> 1 -> 2 with item-1/item-2 appended and confirm-1/confirm-2 appearing after each click's 120 ms delay, status 'hydrated', #static never mutated. This is the LANE-1 witness assertion and is stable across runs.
replay_semantics_vs_historical_pixels.pixel_equality_not_claimed: Do NOT assert the historical PNG shas (det-before c08947dc..., det-after 7488d544...) on a fresh run. The inherited browser-smoke.json already records limits: it observed deviceScaleFactor 1.25 (vs the historical CDP fixture's 1) and explicitly labels itself 'Semantic replay only; no historical pixel equality claim.' Different DPR/viewport produces different PNG bytes for the same semantics.
replay_semantics_vs_historical_pixels.how_to_get_pixel_equality_if_wanted: only by pinning the same viewport as the historical harness: Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride {width:800,height:600,deviceScaleFactor:1,mobile:false} (capture.mjs:155) on a headless chromium with no device-scale override. replay_semantics_vs_historical_pixels.shape_vs_png: DOM shape struct shas (e.g. before struct 3f4f9240199be05f, after struct c8a8e862afae4071 in compare.tsv; shape-text shas d85c76fb.../ba497530...) are more DPR-robust than PNG shas, but only the state-based DOM assertions above are the acceptance predicate.

safe_bounded_replay.preconditions_measured: ports 19411/19412/19461 now free (ss -ltn shows none listening); node v24.21.0 with global WebSocket; chromium 152.0.7977.82; python3 3.14.7 - all present
safe_bounded_replay.recommended_path: CDP driver path over the committed harness, serving the pinned fixture directly from the corpus (read-only, no /tmp staging of the fixture)
steps: 1. Port precheck: ss -ltn | grep -E ':(19411|19412)\b' && { echo FATAL ports busy; exit 10; } || echo 'ports free'
2. Serve the pinned fixture loopback-only: python3 -m http.server 19411 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory corpus/evidence/tabi-r2-1-capture/site > <out>/http.log 2>&1 &  (capture HTTP_PID=$!)

3. Launch an owned headless browser on a loopback debug port with its OWN profile: setsid nohup chromium --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=19412 --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1 --user-data-dir=<out>/profile --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --disable-gpu --disable-background-networking about:blank > <out>/chromium.log 2>&1 &
4. Bounded endpoint wait (10 s envelope): for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:19412/json/version > <out>/json-version.json && break; sleep 0.2; done; curl -sf ... || exit 11
5. Discover the kill list by profile match (never pkill -f): CHROMIUM_PIDS=$(ps -eo pid,args | grep '[c]hromium' | grep "user-data-dir=<out>/profile" | awk '{print $1}')
6. Run the pinned harness det phase against the served page: node corpus/evidence/tabi-r2-1-capture/capture.mjs --phase=det --cdp=19412 --url='http://127.0.0.1:19411/page.html?nondet=off' --out=<out>

7. Read <out>/det.json: expect captures before/before2 count 0 and after count 2 with items [item-1,item-2], confirms [confirm-1,confirm-2], status hydrated; record your own PNG/shape hashes with the run timestamp
8. Close only what you started: kill $CHROMIUM_PIDS; kill $HTTP_PID; sleep 1; escalate kill -9 only to the discovered PIDs if a survivor remains
9. Closure proof: ps -eo pid,args | grep '[c]hromium' | grep 'user-data-dir=<out>/profile' (empty); ss -ltn | grep -E ':(19411|19412)\b' (empty); curl cdp exit=7; curl http exit=7

reasoning: The freshness move's decisive evidence is a browser-path loopback witness (count 0->1->2 + delayed confirmations). A daemon probe (e.g. curl http://127.0.0.1:10086/status) exercises the user's real browser bridge and never touches the lane-authored loopback fixture, so it cannot observe any of the acceptance states.

The webbridge daemon is down: corpus/knowledge/closeout-r11.md:101 ('daemon down - no listener, no process') and closeout-r11.md:143 item O16 ('none current (daemon down; no revived instance)'); webbridge-daemon-disposition.md:275 records no listener on 10086 and states the /status probe stays A3-gated (approval-bound) - the lane must not start a daemon and should not run the probe.

Terminal-only evidence in this repo about the daemon lives in corpus/evidence/tabi-r2-2-state (start/status/final-state) and corpus/evidence/tabi-r2-4-poll (poll.sh/poll.log); both are process/socket observations, not browser fixtures, and neither observes DOM state.
The operating contract also forbids reading identity/session/cookie/log content, so even a live daemon would not be a permitted witness surface for this move.
terminal_only_daemon_checks.conclusion: No terminal-only daemon check should be substituted for, or added to, the loopback browser replay. If L1 wants a daemon line at all, it belongs to a different (daemon/A4) obligation, not to this freshness witness.
